lines.beaver: 발표 잘 들었습니다. 관찰 결과를 정리해 주시겠어요?
lines.beaver_en: Thanks for the talk. Could you sum up your findings?
lines.beaver_roman: Balpyo jal deureotseumnida. Gwanchal gyeolgwareul jeongnihae jusigesseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 올봄 한강공원의 동물과 식물을 관찰했습니다.
lines.en: Yes, this spring I observed animals and plants at Hangang Park.
lines.roman: Ne, olbom hanganggongwonui dongmulgwa singmureul gwanchalhaetseumnida.

lines.learner: 까치가 가장 많았고, 봄에는 제비도 돌아왔습니다.
lines.en: Magpies were the most common, and swallows came back in spring.
lines.roman: Kkachiga gajang manatgo, bomeneun jebido dorawatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Was there anything special about how the birds looked?
lines.learner: 봄이 되자 까치 깃털에 윤기가 돌았습니다.
lines.en: When spring came, the magpies' feathers became glossy.
lines.roman: Bomi doeja kkachi gitteore yungiga doratseumnida.

lines.learner: 야생 동물은 사람을 피하는 법이라 보기 어려웠습니다.
lines.en: Wild animals tend to avoid people, so they were hard to see.
lines.roman: Yasaeng dongmureun sarameul pihaneun beobira bogi eoryeowotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Did you see animals like raccoon dogs in the park?
lines.learner: 아니요, 너구리는 없고 산책하는 애완견이 많았습니다.
lines.en: No, no raccoon dogs, but there were many pet dogs on walks.
lines.roman: Aniyo, neogurineun eopgo sanchaekaneun aewangyeoni manatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Didn't the pets get in the way of observing?
lines.learner: 아니요, 방해가 됐어요. 애완동물이 다가오면 새들이 날아갔어요.
lines.en: Yes, they did. When pets came close, the birds flew away.
lines.roman: Aniyo, banghaega dwaesseoyo. Aewandongmuri dagaomyeon saedeuri naragasseoyo.

lines.en: In early April, cherry blossoms bloomed and new sprouts came up.
lines.roman: Sawol choe beotkkochi pieonago saessakdo dodatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Did they bloom around the same time as last year?
lines.learner: 아니요, 날이 따뜻해서 꽃이 일찍 피었습니다.
lines.en: No, it was warm, so the flowers bloomed early.
lines.roman: Aniyo, nari ttatteutaeseo kkochi iljjik pieotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Did you observe the flowers in the flower beds too?
lines.learner: 네, 장미 같은 화초는 가시가 있어 조심했습니다.
lines.en: Yes, plants like roses have thorns, so I was careful.
lines.roman: Ne, jangmi gateun hwachoneun gasiga isseo josimhaetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: That was an interesting talk. Thank you.
lines.learner: 들어 주셔서 감사합니다. 질문은 언제든 환영합니다.
lines.en: Thank you for listening. Questions are always welcome.
lines.roman: Deureo jusyeoseo gamsahamnida. Jilmuneun eonjedeun hwanyeonghamnida.
